entry.name: IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; machine learning and deep learning with Python
entry.audience: Career changers and developers moving into machine learning engineering

reading.cost: The page states "Join for Free". No price for the certificate is given on the page.
covers: Machine learning, deep learning, neural networks and algorithms such as classification, regression, clustering and dimensional reduction
Supervised and unsupervised models using SciPy and scikit-learn
Deploying machine learning algorithms and pipelines on Apache Spark
Deep learning models and neural networks with Keras, PyTorch and TensorFlow
Large language models and generative AI architectures
Natural language processing, embeddings and transformer models
Computer vision, image and video processing, and object recognition
reading.format: An online Professional Certificate delivered as a 13 course series, available in 19 languages. Learning is assessed through hands-on labs, projects and practical evaluations.
reading.summary: The IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate is a 13 course series offered by IBM on Coursera. It covers machine learning, deep learning and generative AI, including building, training and deploying large language models. Learners complete hands-on labs and projects to build a portfolio. Finishing it shows practical experience with frameworks such as Keras, PyTorch, TensorFlow, SciPy and scikit-learn.
reading.audience: The page says it is ideal for data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers and other technical specialists who want to become job-ready as an AI engineer. It is listed at intermediate level with recommended experience.
reading.prerequisites: The page lists the level as intermediate and refers to recommended experience. It does not state specific requirements.
